label: Where it is now
title: The afterlife, while still alive
lede: Nothing here was liquidated. These are the pieces of the 2011 company and what each has become, as of the filing of August 6, 2026.

items.title: The company
items.text: Groupon, Inc. remains listed on the Nasdaq as GRPN, with headquarters in Chicago and sites in 13 countries. It had 1,734 employees at the end of 2025.[^17]

items.title: The shares
items.text: Every 20 shares became one in June 2020.[^11] 40.7M shares were outstanding in August 2026.[^19] The IPO price of $20 corresponds to $400 for one of them (derived).

items.title: The boardroom
items.text: Pale Fire Capital held nearly 22% in March 2023 and backstopped the $80.0M rights offering that closed in January 2024. Its co-founder has been chief executive since.[^15][^16][^17]

items.title: The founder
items.text: Andrew Mason was replaced on February 28, 2013.[^4] His letter said: “I’m OK with having failed at this part of the journey.”[^24]

items.title: The rival
items.text: LivingSocial was acquired on terms Groupon called “not material” in October 2016. It added incremental gross billings of about $100M in 2017 (derived sum of three categories).[^7][^8]

items.title: The workforce
items.text: From 11,843 at the end of 2014 to 1,734 at the end of 2025.[^5][^17] A plan approved in May 2026 covers up to 400 more positions, including contractors.[^19]

items.title: The idea
items.text: The daily email with one deal and a tipping point is gone. What remains is a marketplace for discounted local services, which the company describes as “a global scaled two-sided marketplace.”[^17]

blocks.title: Who has held the name
blocks.subtitle: The name has never been sold. Control of the company that owns it has changed.

nodes.what: Incorporated in Delaware to run The Point. Groupon begins as a side project that October.[^5][^1]
Venture-backed and founder-led. Turns down Google’s reported offer in December 2010.[^21]
IPO on the Nasdaq at $20 a share.[^1][^23]

nodes.owner: Pale Fire Capital as largest holder
nodes.what: Holds nearly 22%. Its co-founder becomes chief executive, and it backstops the rights offering.[^15][^16]
Still operating and still listed. First-half 2026 revenue of $241.9M.[^19]

blocks.source: Company filings and press releases as cited. Ownership percentages after March 2023 were not checked.
